input.summary: Add a 60 days' non-renewal notice right for Customer to the auto-renewal mechanic
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms with no non-renewal mechanic, so our only exit is the 90 days' notice right available after the Initial Term. We have added a Customer right to decline renewal on 60 days' written notice, which is our fallback position (non-renewal window of no more than 60 days); renewal pricing is unchanged, so no uplift cap is needed.

ops.oldText: The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term"). This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").
ops.newText: The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term"). This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless Customer gives written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days prior to the end of the then-current term, or earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").
